Actual boiler capacity in "tonnes of steam/hour", compared with the design capacity
Actual boiler pressure, compared with the design pressure
Superheated steam temperature, compared with the design value
Actual fuel consumption rate — gas/mazout "g/kWh", compared with the design values
Boiler operation on the different fuel systems "natural gas/mazout"
Adjustment of boiler feedwater specifications to reduce silica and chloride levels
Leak detection tests on the boiler
Results of fuel sample analysis "natural gas, diesel, mazout", noting sulphur and impurity levels in the fuel
Results of hot gas sample analysis at the stack inlet, noting the levels of SOx, NOx and CO gases

Results of water and steam sample analysis from the following locations: (noting the levels of silica, electrical conductivity, hardness and pH — ppb) - Boiler feedwater pump discharge - Water from the Lower Drum - Water from the Upper Drum - Steam from the Upper Drum - Steam from the superheater (S.H. Steam)
Maintenance programmes and their implementation as per MPIS documents "daily, preventive, periodic, major, replacement and renewal"
Periodic tests and maintenance of safety valves on boiler components
Actual fuel pressure and temperature, compared with the design values
Overall efficiency of the main steam boiler
Mazout pumps — pressures, leakages, packing, cleanliness, painting, condition of standby pumps, tests and maintenance carried out on them, and vibration measurements are noted
Diesel pumps — pressures, leakages, packing, cleanliness, painting, condition of standby pumps, tests and maintenance carried out on them, and vibration measurements are noted
Main and daily mazout tanks "condition of the steam heaters in them, their calibration tables, seepage, painting, cleanliness, valves, charging and discharging pumps and lines"
Diesel tanks "condition of the steam heaters in them, their calibration tables, seepage, painting, cleanliness, valves, charging and discharging pumps and lines"
Diesel treatment and washing unit / fuel additive injection "mazout/diesel"
Natural gas pressure reduction station inside the station site
Boiler section workshop "a statement of the main items is attached"
Catalogues and records of the boiler department "a statement of the main records is attached"
2. Gate passes and minor works permits
